def execute_command(image) -> List[ImagePatch]:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    cars = image_patch.find("white car")
    buildings = image_patch.find("white building")
    
    if not cars or not buildings:
        return []
    
    # Find the center of the road
    road_center = sum(car.horizontal_center for car in cars) / len(cars)
    
    # Filter cars that are beside the building
    beside_building = [car for car in cars if abs(car.horizontal_center - road_center) < abs(buildings[0].horizontal_center - road_center)]
    
    return beside_building
